name: tracker-card
description: Compact parcel card with a pill tracking control, conveyor package stage, destination flag, status headline, and a rounded scan mark.
purpose: Puts a single in-transit package on a marketing page so shoppers can read status and open the full track without a dashboard.
bestFor: campaign pages that preview one live parcel
avoidFor: carrier operations dashboards with hundreds of shipments
checkout that still needs a payment form
